children: Brave Wallet has integrated NEAR Intents, enabling one-click cross-chain swaps without bridges or manual gas handling. Brave's Leo AI also runs cryptographically verifiable privacy using NEAR AI trusted execution environments.

The integration exposes NEAR Intents to Brave's browser user base of more than 110 million people, creating a direct adoption and fee channel for the swap infrastructure. The swap flow removes bridge selection and gas management from the user's workflow, while Leo's verifiable AI runs on NEAR AI trusted execution environments. Usage of NEAR Intents through the wallet gives investors a concrete activity metric to monitor over time.
Now powered by NEAR AI + NEAR Intents.
✦ Brave Wallet integrated Intents for one-click cross-chain swaps.
✦ Brave Leo has been running cryptographically-verifiable AI privacy using NEAR AI’s TEEs.

title: NEAR Protocol: Brave Wallet integrates NEAR Intents for one-click cross-chain swaps - 26 Sep 2026
